title: Anyone else's "mallwords" look like this?
content: Weird I came across this sub, wasn't looking for it. I've been having dreams about large old mansions, some having giant recording studios, some containing houses of people I know, some literally being houses of people I know... but almost always without fail they end up being part of a mall? AI can't quite seem to capture the look, they're much less fancy in my dreams, but they never look like normal malls, it's always dirty and rundown with brown and green being prominent colors. Dirty green carpeting and old wooden walls usually, sometimes gray drywall. Occasionally it turns into clean, familiar looking mall, with tiled floor, fountains, white being the most prominent color, but never for long. Always returns to this dingy looking mall with the interior design of some grandma's house. Last dream I had in this setting, I was visiting a friend in another country who I've never met in person, and his 3 story house ended up being inside a mall. I guess the mall also rented housing and he was a tenant. His house and the mall had the same color scheme I mentioned before. Got in trouble for stealing from one of the stores and woke up. Another dream I had was visiting friends of my grandparents in their mansion, which was dangerously falling apart from the inside out, at least the part of the building they were living in. Ended up going to get snacks from the gigantic mall that was built inside of the mansion. It was open to the public and I guess they owned it? Makes me wonder why they didn't fix up the portion of the house they lived in, I remember almost falling through rotting floorboards in that dream. Anway, same color scheme for most areas, but on this occasion some parts of the mall looked normal. Kinda funny so many people experience this. It's been ages since I've even been in a mall, and I'm sure most of you can say the same.
